messages:
Evan Stone: Quick sync 10/28 micro-demo + live AMA aimed at infra PMs and ML platform leads. Need social + creator seeding plan by EOD. Who can take lead on influencer outreach and copy?
Lina Morales: I can run influencer outreach. Prefer to seed 6 creators (mix of infra folks + ML Podcasters). Want to confirm messaging & compensations.
Tariq Shah: For copy ops, suggest 2 organic posts + 1 paid boost. X thread at T0, LI post at T+5m, and creator posts staggered T+10m to avoid clipping.
Becca Sun: Draft headline options for X: 1) "Micro-demo: cut inference bill without sacrificing latency" 2) "How we trimmed per-token costs in production". Which resonates more?
Kai O'Riley: A/B test both. Post option 1 on the official account and option 2 via partner creators. Track with utm_content={headlineA|headlineB}.
Lina Morales: Outreach template to creators: "We'd love you to co-host a 15m demo clip + share a short post. We can offer $500 + promo. Live 10/28 11am PT. Interested?" Want feedback before I send.
Evan Stone: Good. Add "clear opt-out" and note about quoting benchmark numbers: "internal benchmark; results may vary". Also request a short clip (30s) for Reels/X.
Tariq Shah: Ops snippet for scheduling: 
```
X official root -> 2025-10-28 11:00 PT
Pinned reply (register + 2 bullets) -> immediate
LinkedIn long post -> 2025-10-28 11:05 PT
Creator posts (stagger) -> 11:10, 11:20, 11:30 PT
Paid boost -> start 11:00 PT, 6h, split 60/40 X/LI
```
Becca Sun: Creative ask: 1 hero (1200x628), 2 short clips (30s), and 1 benchmark stat image (1200x1200). Lina can collect creator bios for tags.
Lina Morales: I'll DM creators and share bios + deliverables in the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/creative/microdemo_creators. Will also add a column for preferred handle & timezone.
campaign-bot: Reminder set: publish checklist due 2025-10-28 09:30 PT. Campaign created: microdemo_1028. Analytics tag: microdemo_1028.
Kai O'Riley: Engagement playbook (brief): 1) triage replies for 2h, 2) tag "creator-lead" for creator-originated traffic, 3) SDR to follow-up on high-intent within 24h. DM template for SDRs: "Thanks for joining the demo 0could you share team size & infra?"
Tariq Shah: Important: pin registration link in first reply on X and ask creators to include same link + utm params. That raises CTR.
Becca Sun: I've exported alt-text for images and two hero variants (cost-first, latency-first) to the creative folder.
Evan Stone: Budget note: proposing $700 total paid spend. Lina, allocate $200 as creator promo and $500 for paid boosts. Approve?
Lina Morales: Approved. I'll contract creators and confirm deliverables.
Kai O'Riley: Ops will schedule posts in Buffer and handover the seedlist to SDRs post-publish.
Evan Stone: Great. Leave this thread open for any last-minute tweaks. Thanks all :rocket:
